limitations: This describes the RFC 7405 update. It concerns quoted US-ASCII terminals, with rule names and external encodings scoped separately.

statement: RFC 7405 extends ABNF so `%s` quoted US-ASCII literals are case-sensitive and `%i` literals are case-insensitive. An unprefixed quoted literal uses case-insensitive matching.
